narrative.overview: A control-room project ledger that connects large editorial statements to real project evidence. Black and warm paper provide structure while one signal color identifies active state.
keyCharacteristics: Oversized grotesk typography with compact mono readings
Black and warm-paper fields divided by thin rules
Real project screens and authored editorial images at useful scale
Sparse signal colors tied to state or project identity
One explanatory scroll sequence, with direct interactions elsewhere

rules.name: Signal Minority
rules.body: Saturated color occupies a minority of every viewport and marks state or identity.

rules.name: Two-Line Role
rules.body: The role occupies two lines in the first viewport and supporting copy stays to one sentence.

rules.name: Evidence Above Chrome
rules.body: Real media occupies the focal area and decorative chrome never substitutes for evidence.

dos: Lead with the role and real work.
Use one project color at a time and tie it to state.
Preserve keyboard, touch, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Use gradients, glass, decorative blobs, emoji, or glow effects.
Fill entire sections with saturated color.
Scatter scroll effects through the page.
